title: Your target load is on the way...
body: Your target load is personalized based on your age, gender, and heart rate during physical activity. Along with readiness, this target load helps you plan your workouts.

title: Your target load is on the way...
body: Fitbit builds a baseline of your activity patterns and heart rate over several days, to provide you with a personalized daily target cardio load. Along with readiness, target load helps you plan your workouts.
